scope: One combined owned branch/worktree; corrective precommit source blobs below, not a claim about a future rebased or landed SHA.

mechanisms.roster: Native bootstrap creates a guarded additive partial JSON-expression index. Production lookup requires that index and selects only the sending swarm/open lifecycle. Operator existence checks use the same scoped index, including closed history. Registry.list is unchanged.
mechanisms.no_token: The resolver and sender guard share exact boundary/token predicates. Ordinary prose, inside-word emails and lone @ do not read any roster.
mechanisms.authority: Internal verified IdentityFields/IdentityAdmission omit all-seat counts. Root/head/device verification, expiry, custody readiness, outer holds and reopen checks are shared with the truthful full card. Public device attribution remains count-free and survives holds.
mechanisms.custody: The existing observation cache holds verified count-free fields, refreshed by both card and admission reads. Native custody controls consume that metadata and cold-read public fields without a new key attempt. Only the existing pure local custody decorator was generalized; unlock/key/enrollment policy is unchanged.
mechanisms.full_card: Full identity status still collects its real count and returns an error on malformed count input; no placeholder count or swallowed corruption.

runtime_witness: advertised-old MCP7 -> 8; same current binary both launches; supervisor=83405 old_logic=83406 new_logic=84712; generation/process/native-session and real shell state retained; signed mention admitted wake=now
assertions: Indexed SEARCH, no SCAN kv; version and user_version remain1; legacy raw connection writes rename/move/open/closed state and fresh lookups observe them.
1024 foreign seats plus malformed JSON/record cannot break local signed mention through real MCP and Unix GUI sockets.
Unreadable local non-recipient refuses genuine mention lookup but email/lone-@ sends keep original text and empty IDs through both sockets.
Corrupt counts fail full cards while root/device/head forgery, expiry, holds and reopen still refuse signing.
Cached, initially empty and held custody control reads perform no additional DeviceKeyStore.load operation.
Unchanged native two-item regrant, pending-order, held/reopen and local custody suites pass.
